description: Remove all dead code from the old deterministic workflow engine after M1 agent architecture is complete. Delete workflow/ and agent/ directories, remove TaskRepo infrastructure, remove dead API endpoints and CLI commands, clean Stage enum, clean ServerState and server status display.

tasks.description: Delete the following files: workflow/engine.ts, workflow/issue-workflow.ts, workflow/stage-handlers.ts, agent/runner.ts, agent/prompts.ts. Delete the empty workflow/ and agent/ directories.
tasks.notes: Safe deletion — no active code imports these files. workflow-service.ts imports issue-workflow.ts but workflow-service.ts is deleted in T-004. After T-001, workflow-service.ts will have a broken import — that's expected and resolved by T-003+T-004.

tasks.title: Delete old workflow and agent test files
tasks.description: Delete tests/engine.test.ts and tests/agent-runner.test.ts. These test the deleted workflow engine and agent runner.
tasks.notes: Safe deletion — these tests only test deleted code. Run independently from T-001.

tasks.title: Remove WorkflowService and dead endpoints from api/issues.ts
tasks.description: In api/issues.ts: (1) Remove the WorkflowService import and instantiation (line 4, line 24). (2) Remove the /approve endpoint (lines 375-423). (3) Remove the /resume endpoint (lines 433-512). (4) Remove the /pause endpoint (lines 425-431). (5) Remove progress and stageInfo from the show endpoint response (lines 138-139, 149-150). Keep all active endpoints: list, create, show, update, comments, start, close, reopen, cleanup.

POST /:number/resume endpoint does not exist in api/issues.ts
POST /:number/pause endpoint does not exist in api/issues.ts
GET /:number response does not include progress or stageInfo
IssueService constructor call does not pass TaskRepo
tasks.notes: After this task, WorkflowService is only referenced by services/index.ts (T-004) and IssueService no longer takes TaskRepo (T-005 updates IssueService itself). The start endpoint is active and must be preserved. Note: removing stateManager.getTaskRepo() from line 22 means IssueService constructor now takes only 1 argument — T-005 will update the IssueService class to match.

tasks.title: Delete services/workflow-service.ts
tasks.description: Delete services/workflow-service.ts and remove the WorkflowService, STAGE_ORDER, and TransitionResult exports from services/index.ts.
tasks.notes: Depends on T-003 removing all WorkflowService usage from api/issues.ts. After T-001 deleted issue-workflow.ts, workflow-service.ts has a broken import — but that's OK because T-004 deletes it entirely.

tasks.title: Remove TaskRepo from IssueService, StateManager, and api/issues.ts constructor
tasks.description: (1) In services/issue-service.ts: Remove TaskRepo import and constructor parameter. Inline cascade delete: change delete() to call this.issueRepo.deleteCascade(issueId), change deleteByProject() to call this.issueRepo.deleteByProjectCascade(projectId). Add deleteCascade() and deleteByProjectCascade() methods to db/issue-repo.ts that run DELETE FROM tasks before the main delete. (2) In server/state-manager.ts: Remove TaskRepo import, field (line 17), instantiation (line 29), getter getTaskRepo() (lines 165-167), and all task-related methods (loadTasks, getRunningTasks, getPendingTasks, createTask, updateTaskStatus, setTaskAgentPid, clearTaskAgentPid, recoverState). In deleteProject() (line 63), remove this.taskRepo.deleteByProject(id) — the cascade is now handled by IssueRepo. (3) In server/index.ts: Remove the recoverState() call (line 84) and the activeTasks log (lines 89-91). (4) In api/issues.ts: The IssueService constructor call was already fixed in T-003 (removed getTaskRepo() argument). No further changes needed here.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueService constructor does not take TaskRepo parameter
tasks.notes: The only legitimate TaskRepo usage was cascade delete in IssueService.delete()/deleteByProject() and StateManager.deleteProject(). All move to IssueRepo as direct SQL. StateManager.deleteProject() currently calls this.taskRepo.deleteByProject(id) then this.issueRepo.deleteByProject(id) — after this change, it calls this.issueRepo.deleteByProjectCascade(projectId) which handles both internally.

tasks.title: Delete db/task-repo.ts, add migrateToVersion3 to drop tasks table
tasks.description: (1) Delete db/task-repo.ts. (2) Remove TaskRepo, CreateTaskData, TaskQueryOptions exports from db/index.ts. (3) In db/migrations.ts: Add migrateToVersion3() that runs 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tasks' and 'DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_tasks_project_status'. Bump SCHEMA_VERSION to 3. Add version 3 check in initializeDatabase(). (4) Remove CREATE_TASKS_TABLE and the idx_tasks_project_status index from runMigrations() (since v3 drops the table, no point creating it for fresh installs either — but actually, fresh installs go through runMigrations at version 0 then immediately hit version 3 check; simpler to just let v3 drop it).
acceptanceCriteria: db/index.ts does not export TaskRepo, CreateTaskData, or TaskQueryOptions
Server startup drops the tasks table if it exists
tasks.notes: Depends on T-005 removing all TaskRepo references from active code. Uses the existing lightweight migration mechanism (version check + function), not a new framework.

No WaitingDesignReview or WaitingReview in types/index.ts
